rules.text: Do not apply Sikalastic®-590 Plus AU on substrates with rising moisture.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: In cold climatic zones, Sikalastic®-590 Plus AU should not be applied on roofs subject to ponding water with subsequent periods of frost
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not apply Sikalastic®-590 Plus AU directly on insulation boards
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Sikalastic®-590 Plus AU requires a suitable metal primer on all metal substrates prior to membrane application .
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Use a suitable bond breaker over joints and prime before applying Sikalastic®-590 Plus AU. (Contact Sika Technical for advice on joint sealing before application of membrane)
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: Bituminous Sheets/Coatings: Bituminous sheet membranes should not have sticky or mobile surfaces and should be thouroughly cleaned
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: Use suitable bond breaker over any existing joints. (Contact Sika Technical for advice on joint sealing before application of membrane)
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: Volatile mastic coatings, old coal tar coatings, bitumen based liquid membranes should not have sticky or mobile surfaces and should be thouroughly cleaned
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
